objective: One job per stat with wave fights on a clock, role jobs without a rock paper scissors loop, new hatch odds (15 at 1 in 90, jackpot 1 in 10,000), training times that rise to 24 to 48 hours per level above 60, and XP for creature level-ups.
acceptance_criteria: Each stat changes exactly one battle number: Speed the swing, Stamina the rest, Strength the damage, Mana the energy per attack, Health the HP, Defence the damage cut
A base level of 15 is exactly 1 in 90 with even steps down, and the jackpot is 1 in 10,000
Every stat level takes longer than the one before, never by more than 15%, with levels 61 to 70 taking 24 to 48 hours
Training settles in real time with no offline cap and pays XP for every stat level gained
Wave fights have no role matchup bonus and always end; the weakest starting trio clears wave 4
